meta.title: Bill Formatter — Invoice Processing, Distribution and On-Demand Servicing

lanes.name: Source Systems
lanes.hint: Oracle BRM, Mediation Zone, Product Catalogue, Legacy Invoice Buffer

lanes.name: Bill Formatter
lanes.hint: Core ingestion, generation, masking and orchestration engine

lanes.name: Billing Operations
lanes.hint: Admin Console users — review, reprocess, configure, action

lanes.name: Siebel CRM
lanes.hint: Reprint/resend requests, hot bill landing, notification logging

lanes.name: Distribution Channels
lanes.hint: SMTP, SMS Gateway, WhatsApp Business, Web

nodes.label: Bill Run / On-Demand Trigger
nodes.desc: Regular bill cycle run, trial bill run, or hot bill request initiates XML retrieval (BFR_XML_001.01/.02/.03).

nodes.label: Pull Regular Bill XML
nodes.desc: Formatter pulls invoice XML from Mediation Zone for regular bills at the predefined input location. Integration: INT-01 (Oracle BRM via Mediation Zone, invoice XML supply and regeneration request). Status Model — XML Record: Received (XML file collected or uploaded and awaiting validation).

nodes.label: Pull Trial Bill XML
nodes.desc: Formatter pulls invoice XML from Mediation Zone for trial bills at the predefined input location. Integration: INT-01 (Oracle BRM via Mediation Zone, invoice XML supply and regeneration request). Status Model — XML Record: Received (XML file collected or uploaded and awaiting validation).

nodes.label: Pull Hot Bill XML
nodes.desc: Formatter pulls invoice XML from Mediation Zone for hot bills at the predefined input location. Integration: INT-01 (Oracle BRM via Mediation Zone, invoice XML supply and regeneration request). Status Model — XML Record: Received (XML file collected or uploaded and awaiting validation).

nodes.label: Manual XML / ZIP Upload
nodes.desc: Manual XML and ZIP upload, restricted to authorised users, as an alternative ingestion path.

nodes.label: Atomic File Write
nodes.desc: XML is written to a temporary location or filename, closed and verified, then renamed/moved to the final destination so no partially written file is readable downstream.

nodes.label: Duplicate Prevention Check
nodes.desc: The same invoice XML file is not processed more than once.

nodes.label: Batch Creation
nodes.sub: BR-003 / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.02 / P-22 / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.03 / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.04 / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.04.A_ViewBill_Action / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.04.B_ViewBill_StatusLog / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.04.Cx_ViewBill_Download_PDF / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.04.D_ViewBill_Download_PDF / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.04.E_ViewBill_Download_XML / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.04.F_ViewBill_Reprint_Bill / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.04.G_ViewBill_Regenerate_Document / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.04.H_ViewBill_Regenerate_XML / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.04.I_ViewBill_Send_Email / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.06_Action_Overall_Report / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.07_Action_Detailed_Report / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.08_Action_Failed_Report / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.09_Action_Failed_Emails_Report / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.10_Action_Send_Overall_Report / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.11_Action_Send_Email / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.15
nodes.desc: XML files are retrieved and processed batch-wise; each collection cycle produces a single batch identifier. P-22 (maximum batch size). Status Model — Batch: Created (batch created from the loaded XML files).

nodes.label: XML Schema & Mandatory Data Validation
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter loads the XML, performs schema validation, and validates mandatory billing data required for invoice generation. Status Model — XML Record: Valid (XML has passed schema and mandatory data validation).

nodes.label: Failed XML — Reason Recorded
nodes.desc: XML failing schema or mandatory data validation is marked Failed XML with a recorded failure reason; it does not proceed to invoice generation. Status Model — XML Record: Failed XML (XML has failed schema or mandatory data validation and carries a failure reason).

nodes.label: Failed XML Visible in Portal
nodes.desc: Failed XML records are visible in the Bill Formatter Portal with failure reason and processing status.

nodes.label: Review & Reprocess Failed XML
nodes.desc: Billing Operations users review failed XML records and initiate reprocessing after corrective action.

nodes.label: Retry per Configured Policy
nodes.desc: Retrieval errors are retried per the configured retry policy; a persistent failure is raised for operational review. Retry count: to be confirmed (P-19).

nodes.label: Log Retrieval / Load Status
nodes.desc: Retrieval and load status is logged for every XML file; batch statistics reflect successful and failed outcomes.

nodes.label: Derive Invoice Type & Customer Segment
nodes.desc: Invoice type and customer segment are derived from the loaded XML content.

nodes.label: Load & Parse XML
nodes.desc: Invoice Header, Invoice Summary and Invoice Detail structures are loaded from the parsed XML. Status Model — XML Record: Processed (XML has been consumed by invoice generation; terminal).

nodes.label: Supporting CSV Presence Check
nodes.desc: Scheduler checks every 10 minutes (P-01) whether an expected supporting CSV has been received.

nodes.label: Supporting CSV Absent Alert
nodes.desc: Where a supporting CSV remains absent 4 hours after XML receipt (P-02), an alert email is issued to the configured recipients. Integration: INT-04 (Alerting recipients, operational alert distribution).

nodes.label: Batch Ready
nodes.desc: Batch validated and available for invoice generation.

nodes.label: Bill Type?
nodes.desc: Status Model — Invoice: Pending (invoice awaiting generation).

nodes.label: Generate Regular Bill
nodes.sub: BR-025 / BR-031 / BFR_INV_PDF_REG_003.01 / BFR_INV_PDF_REG_003.02 / BFR_INV_PDF_REG_003.03 / BFR_INV_PDF_REG_003.04 / BFR_INV_XLS_REG_001.01 / BFR_INV_XLS_REG_001.02 / BFR_OLD_INV_COMP_001.01
nodes.desc: Regular bill PDF generated using the template applicable to Consumer Mobile, Consumer Fixed Line, Enterprise and Black; XLS and CSV also produced for Enterprise. BR-031 (all information/business rules currently defined within the existing legacy formatter carry forward into this capability).

nodes.label: Generate Trial Bill
nodes.sub: BR-020 / BR-021 / BR-022 / BFR_INV_PDF_TRL_003.01 / BFR_INV_PDF_TRL_003.02 / BFR_INV_PDF_TRL_003.03 / BFR_INV_PDF_TRL_003.04 / BFR_INV_XLS_TRL_001.01 / BFR_INV_XLS_TRL_001.02
nodes.desc: Trial bill PDF generated by customer segment (Consumer Mobile, Consumer Fixed Line, Enterprise, Black) for internal audit and bill validation only; a trial run covers an entire bill cycle or a nominated customer list. Trial bills are never distributed to a customer through any channel.

nodes.label: Generate Hot Bill
nodes.sub: BR-024 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.12 / BFR_INV_PDF_HOT_003.01 / BFR_INV_PDF_HOT_003.02 / BFR_INV_PDF_HOT_003.03 / BFR_INV_XLS_HOT_001.01 / BFR_INV_XLS_HOT_001.02
nodes.desc: Hot bill PDF generated using the template applicable to Consumer, Enterprise and Black; XLS and CSV also produced for Enterprise.

nodes.label: Generate Bulk SMS Invoice
nodes.desc: Bulk SMS invoices generated using the Bulk SMS invoice template for regular, trial and hot bills.

nodes.label: Generate IoT Invoice
nodes.desc: IoT invoices generated using the IoT invoice template for regular, trial and hot bills.

nodes.label: Determine Invoice Language
nodes.desc: Invoice language is determined from the language type identifier in the source data; English and Arabic (P-08) are supported with the corresponding template and translation values applied.

nodes.label: Populate Calculated Fields
nodes.desc: Fields requiring calculation and not directly available from source systems are calculated using logic supplied by the billing system (D-07 dependency) and populated in the output.

nodes.label: Enterprise Detailed Output
nodes.desc: An Enterprise customer opted for the detailed bill receives an XLS output; a call detail CSV is produced in the VFQ approved format and stored in the designated output location.

nodes.label: Generation Successful?
nodes.desc: Status Model — Invoice: Generated (invoice output produced in the required format).

nodes.label: Invoice Generation Failed
nodes.desc: Invoices failing processing or generation carry a recorded failure status and reason, visible in the portal. Status Model — Batch: Failed (batch processing failed) / Invoice: Failed (invoice generation failed and carries a failure reason).

nodes.label: Reprocess Failed Invoice
nodes.desc: Reprocessing of a failed invoice or batch is restricted by role; the retry count is recorded. Maximum retry attempts: to be confirmed (P-20).

nodes.label: Trial Batch Excluded from Channel Upload
nodes.desc: Trial batches are excluded from channel upload — a trial bill exists only for internal audit and bill validation.

nodes.label: Original Invoice Remains Unchanged
nodes.desc: The original customer invoice is generated, stored and remains unchanged and immutable.

nodes.label: Generate Masked Invoice
nodes.desc: A separate masked invoice file is generated at the point of invoice generation for each applicable invoice. Tax Identifier, Payment Method and Phone Number are masked in accordance with the configured access policy (masking rule set: D-08 dependency, to be confirmed). BR-153 (masking rules configurable without requiring invoice regeneration).

nodes.label: Role-Based Invoice Presentation
nodes.desc: User role and access permission determine whether the full invoice or the masked invoice is presented; privileged roles view the full invoice, restricted roles view the masked version. Bill download offers an Agent Copy and a Customer Copy.

nodes.label: Billing Operations Review
nodes.desc: Invoice review and approval before customer despatch, following role-based access, when the review switch is enabled. Status Model — Invoice: Approved (invoice reviewed and approved for despatch where the review switch is on).

nodes.label: Invoice Rejected — Despatch Prevented
nodes.desc: Invoice reviewed and rejected; despatch is prevented. Returns to Pending on regeneration.

nodes.label: Make Invoice Available to Channels
nodes.desc: Generated invoices are made available to downstream channels through the configured integration flow, with regular bill copies provided to Siebel CRM and other customer channels. P-09 (supported invoice output formats).

nodes.label: Hot Bill Landing Location
nodes.desc: Hot bill invoices are placed in the Siebel CRM hot bill landing location and are available in real time following generation (target time: to be confirmed, P-21).

nodes.label: Email Eligible?
nodes.desc: Status Model — Email: Eligible (invoice identified as eligible for email distribution).

nodes.label: Determine Email Template
nodes.desc: Email template determined by customer type, invoice type and language; separate templates for Consumer and Enterprise in English and Arabic, with configurable dynamic fields.

nodes.label: Suppression List Check
nodes.desc: A configurable list of non-triable email addresses is maintained against which no despatch is attempted.

nodes.label: Email Suppressed
nodes.desc: Despatch not attempted because the address is on the non-triable list. Terminal.

nodes.label: SMTP Despatch
nodes.desc: Email despatched through the configured SMTP service, which captures delivery feedback and provides success/failure reporting.

nodes.label: Email Despatch Failed
nodes.sub: Status Model — Email: Failed / BR-062 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.13_Failed_Email
nodes.desc: Delivery failed; failure reported in the Failed Email Report. Resend on retry. Status Model — Batch: Failed Sending Email (one or more invoice emails within the batch failed despatch) / Invoice: Failed Sending Email (invoice email despatch failed).

nodes.label: Email Sent — Awaiting Delivery Feedback
nodes.desc: Status Model — Invoice: Email Sent (invoice email despatched to the customer; terminal).

nodes.label: Email Delivered
nodes.desc: Delivery confirmed by the SMTP service feedback. Terminal.

nodes.label: Log CRM Notification
nodes.desc: A CRM notification record is created only for invoices processed for customer communication, stored against the customer account and bill reference for servicing and audit. Integration: INT-02 (Siebel CRM, reprint/resend request receipt, invoice delivery, notification logging).

nodes.label: SMS Invoice Notification
nodes.desc: Invoice communication via SMS, carrying a PDF reference or an invoice URL, with pre-despatch masking applied (BR-053).

nodes.label: WhatsApp Invoice Notification
nodes.desc: Invoice communication via WhatsApp Business through the approved provider, carrying a PDF reference or an invoice URL, with pre-despatch masking applied (BR-053).

nodes.label: Web Channel Display
nodes.desc: Invoice communication supported through the Web channel, with pre-despatch masking applied (BR-053).

nodes.label: Trial Bill — Not Distributed
nodes.desc: A trial bill is generated for internal audit and bill validation only and is never distributed to a customer through any channel. Terminal.

nodes.label: Reprint Bill Request
nodes.desc: A reprint request carries the account number, bill period and bill type; the reprinted PDF is transferred through Mediation Zone to the requesting channel. Integration: INT-02 (Siebel CRM, reprint/resend request receipt, invoice delivery, notification logging).

nodes.label: Resend Bill Request
nodes.desc: A resend request carries the account number and bill reference; only a previously generated invoice may be resent, and delivery status is recorded and visible. Integration: INT-02 (Siebel CRM, reprint/resend request receipt, invoice delivery, notification logging).

nodes.label: Invoice / Batch Regeneration Request
nodes.desc: Invoice regeneration supported at both individual invoice level and batch level, including retry and status reporting.

nodes.label: Legacy Invoice Buffer Lookup
nodes.desc: Invoices are regenerable from legacy XML data held in the Invoice Buffer table, including invoices generated several years previously.

nodes.label: Invoice Unavailable for Regeneration
nodes.desc: Fallback behaviour: report the invoice as unavailable for regeneration.

nodes.label: Consume Latest Corrected XML
nodes.desc: Where the source XML has been regenerated or corrected, regeneration consumes the latest version.

nodes.label: Generate Reprint PDF
nodes.sub: BR-044 / BR-045 / BFR_CONSL_BATCH_001.03.A_ViewBill_Status_Log / BFR_INV_REPRNT_001.01 / BFR_INV_REPRNT_001.02 / BFR_INV_REPRNT_001.03.B / BFR_INV_REPRNT_001.03.C / BFR_INV_REPRNT_001.03.D / BFR_INV_REPRNT_001.03.E / BFR_INV_REPRNT_001.03.F / BFR_INV_REPRNT_001.03.G / BFR_INV_REPRNT_001.03.H / BFR_INV_REPRNT_001.03_Reprint_Bills
nodes.desc: Reprint does not alter the original invoice data; only a previously generated bill may be reprinted. Supports Detailed or Summarised bill type and English or Arabic language.

nodes.label: Reprint / Resend Register
nodes.desc: Reprint and resend requests are displayed in dedicated console registers with status and process date.

nodes.label: Resend via Distinct Template
nodes.desc: The resend email template may differ from the first-time bill email template and is separately maintainable in English and Arabic. Existing reprint/resend interface signatures remain unchanged (parallel running, no impact to current channels).

nodes.label: Update Batch Statistics
nodes.desc: Batch statistics display successful and failed PDF generation with identifier, bill number, account number, status and reason. BR-072 (processing status maintained/displayed at batch and item level). BR-073 (supported operational status values: Failed, Ready, Report Generated, Invoice Completed, Failed Sending Email). Status Model — Batch: Report Generated (batch reports have been produced).

nodes.label: Admin Console — Batch / Bill / Hot Bill Actions
nodes.sub: BR-070 / BR-074 / BR-075 / BR-071 / BR-076 / BR-077 / BR-079 / BFR_ADM_CONSL_001.01 / BFR_HOT_BILL_DTLS_002.01 / BFR_HOT_BILL_DTLS_002.02 / BFR_HOT_BILL_DTLS_002.03_Status_Log / BFR_HOT_BILL_DTLS_002.04_Download_pdf / BFR_HOT_BILL_DTLS_002.05_Download_Xls / BFR_HOT_BILL_DTLS_002.06_Download_xml / BFR_HOT_BILL_DTLS_002.07_Reprint_Bill / BFR_HOT_BILL_DTLS_002.08_regenerate_Document / BFR_HOT_BILL_DTLS_002.09_Regenerate_xml / BFR_HOT_BILL_DTLS_002.10_Send_Email
nodes.desc: Front-end Admin Console for Billing Operations covering batches, bills, hot bills, XML records, reports, translations and role-based access. Batch action menu: View Bills, View Statistics, Overall Report, Detail Report, Failed Report, Failed Email Report, Send Overall Report, Send Email. Bill action menu (applies equally to the hot bill register): Status Log, Download PDF, Download XLS, Download XML, Reprint Bill, Regenerate Document, Regenerate XML, Send Email. BR-071 (batch list displays identifier, date created, reference, status). BR-076 (status log displays identifier, label, reason, date created). BR-077 (selected bill downloadable in PDF, XLS and XML). BR-079 (hot bill register displays identifier, process date, bill number).

nodes.label: Search & Retrieve Invoices / Reports / XML
nodes.sub: BR-090 / BR-091 / BR-092 / BR-093 / BFR_CONSL_INV_SEARCH_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_SEARCH_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_XML_SEARCH_001.01
nodes.desc: Search across invoice type, invoice number, batch identifier, date created, language, MSISDN, product, status, email address, account number, customer type and internal identifier. Results support download, regenerate, reprocess and email actions by role and status. BR-093 (configuration records open in a separate window/pop-up on drill-down).

nodes.label: Reference Data Configuration
nodes.sub: BR-100/BR-101/BR-102/BR-103/BR-104/BR-105/BR-106/BR-107/BR-108/BR-109/BR-110/BR-111/BR-112/BR-113 / P-11 / INT-08 / BFR_CONSL_ADJ_RSN_CONF_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_ADJ_RSN_CONF_001.02_Create / BFR_CONSL_ADJ_RSN_CONF_001.02_Edit / BFR_CONSL_BANNER_CONF_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_CONSL_BENEFIT_CONF_001.01_Benefit_Configure / BFR_CONSL_CONSL_BENEFIT_CONF_001.02_Benefit_Edit_Delete / BFR_CONSL_CONSL_BENEFIT_CONF_001.03_Benefit_Create / BFR_CONSL_CONSL_BENEFIT_CONF_001.04_Benefit_Search / BFR_CONSL_CONSL_CONF_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_CONSL_CONF_001.02 / BFR_CONSL_EML_TEMP_CONF_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_FLEX_BKT_CONF_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_FLEX_BKT_CONF_001.02 / BFR_CONSL_FLEX_BKT_CONF_001.03 / BFR_CONSL_PLAN_SPEED_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_VAS_CONF_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_VAS_CONF_001.02 / BFR_CONSL_VAS_CONF_001.03 / BFR_SETTNG_CONSL_TRNSL_CONF_001.01 / BFR_SETTNG_CONSL_TRNSL_CONF_001.02
nodes.desc: Translation, adjustment reason, benefits, flex bucket, VAS short code and plan speed configuration, with import/export, effective dating and role control; benefit/flex bucket/VAS/plan speed synchronise with the product catalogue where applicable. P-11 (configuration export and import formats). Integration: INT-08 (Product Catalogue, configuration synchronisation).

nodes.label: Template & Presentation Configuration
nodes.sub: BR-120/BR-121/BR-122/BR-123/BR-124 / BFR_CONSL_BILL_TEMPLATE_CONF_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_CONF_DRL_DWN_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_INTRCT_PDF_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_INTRCT_PDF_001.02 / BFR_INVC_TEMPLT_CHNG_001.01 / BFR_INVOICE__BUS_RULE_001.01 / REQ_BFR_006
nodes.desc: Bill template field maintenance by segment and invoice type; bill banner configuration with page-overlap handling; report template configuration; interactive PDF tabs and dynamic links.

nodes.label: Reporting & Dashboards
nodes.sub: BR-130/BR-131/BR-132/BR-133/BR-134/BR-135/BR-136/BR-137/BR-138/BR-139/BR-140/BR-141/BR-142 / P-03 / P-04 / P-05 / P-06 / P-07 / P-10 / BFR_CONSL_DASH_BRD_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_EML_TEMP_CONF_001.02 / BFR_CONSL_OPR_STAT_001.02 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.01 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.02 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.03 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.04 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.05 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.06 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.07 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.08 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.09 / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.10_BiullRunMonitor / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.11_VLB / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.12_Overall / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.13_Internal / BFR_CONSL_REP_001.14_Failed_Bill_Report / BFR_DATA_SORTING_001.01
nodes.desc: Enterprise reports (CDR List, Credit File, Invoice Report), operational dashboard, batch reports, failed bill/email reports, processing statistics, bill run monitor and hot bill failure alerts. Reports generated daily, monthly, after bill run or ad hoc, in PDF, CSV or Excel; no print media output produced (BR-132). P-03 (hot bill failure report interval). P-04 (bill run days). P-05 (bill run monitor interval). P-06 (delivery preference PDF only, code 0). P-07 (delivery preference PDF and XLS, code 3). P-10 (supported report output formats).

nodes.label: Storage & Retention Housekeeping
nodes.desc: Generated invoices, reports, XML files and emails are retained for the configured duration; artefacts exceeding the retention period are removed automatically. Retention periods: to be confirmed (P-14/P-15/P-16/P-17/P-18).

nodes.label: Batch Processing Complete
nodes.desc: All invoice outputs within the batch generated and email despatch complete. Status Model — Batch: Invoice Completed (all invoice outputs within the batch have been generated).

nodes.label: Currency & Tax Handling
nodes.desc: Currency information received in the source billing data is used to generate the invoice in that currency (BR-161); base currency is Qatari Riyal (P-13). Tax information received in the source data is processed and displayed on the invoice (BR-162).
